summary: Milestone 2A end-to-end verification. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests pass (14 baseline in backend_test.py + 15 new in test_m2a.py) — employee PIN login (RMJ001/0001), owner set-pin, store settings GET/PUT, geo-fence + selfie validation, check-in/check-out with working_hours, corrections + leaves create/list/decide with side effects (attendance stub + timeline event), dashboard pending-approval counters, and no _id/pin_hash leakage. Frontend (390x844): owner login → Dashboard renders, 4-tab bottom bar (Dashboard/Attendance/Employees/Settings) is present and navigable, attendance-screen renders Today/Live sub-tabs and lists all seeded employees with status pills, approvals-btn opens approvals-screen with Corrections/Leaves sub-tabs (approved TEST correction visible from backend test), settings-store-btn opens store-settings-screen (fields editable + Use my current location + Save), pin-btn on employee profile opens set-pin-screen. Employee login (RMJ001/0001) reaches emp-home-screen with greeting, avatar initial, Punch card (Check In / Check Out slots), Quick actions row (Correction / Apply Leave). btn-check-in opens punch-modal and correctly renders 'Camera access needed' + 'Waiting for location…' permission UI without crashing — expected for headless web preview. No red-screen/pageerror events observed. RN-web console warning noted: props.pointerEvents is deprecated (unchanged from iter 2).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly returns projections without _id/pin_hash on every read path (list, get, timeline, dashboard) — verified via string-search assertions in tests.
PIN backfill on startup uses last 4 digits of employee_code — matches memory/test_credentials.md (0001..0005).
geofence check runs BEFORE selfie check in check_in/check_out — good ordering; both are strictly required per spec.
Attendance idempotency uses unique index (employee_id, date) — server.py:173 — plus explicit 'Already checked in' guard: robust.
Approved correction adds a stub attendance row with working_hours=8 — matches payroll expectations.
